description: Every Pub/Sub topic and subscription Riffle uses. Terraform (infra/terraform/modules/pubsub) reads this file, so adding a topic is a change here. Each subscription gets a dead-letter topic named <topic>-dead-letter and a hold subscription on it, so a message that failed max_delivery_attempts times is kept, not dropped.

topics.name: pr-events
topics.about: PrEvent from intake: one per pull request trigger

topics.name: score-results
topics.about: ScoreResult from the scorer, after it is committed to Postgres

topics.name: score-log
topics.about: One row per score with the features the scorer saw (ADR 0024); never on the scoring path

topics.name: installation-events
topics.about: GitHub installation events from intake, for the tenant workflow (ADR 0025)

topics.name: outcome-events
topics.about: What happened to PRs after scoring (closed or merged, pushes to the default branch, check results), for the outcome labeler
